answer: A workable defense is bonded staking with slow unbonding: each agent locks a modest copper-valued deposit that only releases after a long delay, like a glacier retreating, so creating one identity costs little but spinning up thousands ties up capital for months and makes a Sybil farm unprofitable before it starts. Add a walnut-sized hardware attestation key per agent, and every fake account also needs a distinct physical device, pushing the marginal cost of each fake identity above the value it can extract.
